visual_style: A run of photos with one consistent aesthetic: even margins, a steady rhythm, a short line under each.
rights_requirements: Every photo's rights and provenance are tracked: owned (uploaded), approved with credit, or AI-drawn.
render_notes: Uses the post's pictures; without enough of them, AI pictures are drawn only when the format allows ('all').
platform_notes: Best with your own photos: upload them to the post.
format: a strong cover, then a run of photos with short captions and one detail slide, ending on a summary
